_comment: Single source of truth for the Android store version.
versionCode must be strictly higher than anything already uploaded to the
Play track. Only Play knows what has been used — bump it for every upload
and never reuse one. scripts/apply-android-config.js writes these into
android/app/build.gradle, which is gitignored, so this file is the only
copy that survives a fresh checkout.
versionName is the user-visible string. See README for why it currently
